summary: Razorpay demo-mode regression PASSED end-to-end. Backend pytest (/app/backend/tests/test_payments_razorpay.py) — 15/15 passed in 4s: GET /api/payments/config -> {enabled:false, key_id:null}; POST /api/customer/bookings with payment_method=upi and =card both return pending/paid/demo booking (no razorpay object in response) and clear the cart; wallet /topup ₹100 adds balance (bounds reject 0 and 20000); /payments/verify guards unauthenticated 401, 422 on empty body, 404 for unknown order; /payments/cancel idempotent 200; /payments/razorpay/webhook returns 503 when secret absent; language roundtrip hi/en persists for customer+partner. Frontend smoke (390x844) using customer 9800000001/1234: app loaded with RazorpayProvider mounted (no crash, no red screen, only cosmetic warnings - shadow*, pointerEvents, useNativeDriver web); home-voice-search-btn and chatbot-voice-btn both still render (STT regression OK); /checkout shows the demo note 'Demo payment mode (Razorpay keys not configured)' via testID checkout-payment-mode-note; placing a UPI booking (serv_paint_01 added via api) navigated to /booking/bk_6363cfcf8a9c with Total (UPI · paid) ₹3,538.82; /wallet top-up ₹100 button fires without error. Code review of razorpay.tsx / RazorpaySheet(.tsx|.web.tsx) confirms the three fields razorpay_order_id, razorpay_payment_id, razorpay_signature exactly match backend VerifyIn, cancel sends order_id matching CancelIn, and the `closed` flag in web variant correctly prevents double-firing dismiss after success. No deprecated Expo packages found. No react-native issues.
critical_code_review_comments: razorpay.tsx onDismiss uses job?.order.order_id but captures via setJob state; closure reads latest job via render — OK because the component remounts RazorpaySheet when job is set. No stale-closure risk.

RazorpaySheet.web.tsx uses `useEffect(..., [])` so it opens checkout once; if the parent passes a new order without unmounting it won't reopen. Current RazorpayProvider sets `job` and remounts the sheet on each pay() call, so this works, but worth a code comment for future maintainers.

RazorpaySheet.tsx (native) does not currently expose onError from Razorpay (payment.failed handler is empty) — on real failure the WebView will just stay open until user dismisses. Acceptable for v1 (dismiss -> cancel API) but main agent could post {type:'error'} from payment.failed to surface a toast quicker.
routes_payments.py fulfil(): if pay['purpose']=='booking' and booking is missing (b is None), code will crash on b['status']. Add a None check before touching b (low priority, race condition only).

success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke (login + voice buttons + demo UPI checkout -> /booking + wallet topup)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Razorpay is in demo mode (RAZORPAY_KEY_ID empty in /app/backend/.env). To test real checkout, main agent needs to add RAZORPAY_KEY_ID/RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET from Razorpay dashboard, then re-run test_payments_razorpay.py expecting /api/payments/config.enabled=true and bookings to return a `razorpay` object. The frontend test file test_payments_razorpay.py reads env var REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL) — pass it explicitly when running pytest, e.g. REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://tri-module-app.preview.emergentagent.com pytest. Main app layout wraps RazorpayProvider in /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx (correct). Payment-mode note testID: checkout-payment-mode-note. Razorpay checkout modal testID (native only): razorpay-checkout.
